I made two changes:

- **Migration:** I added `migrations/003_expert_timezone.sql`, which runs `alter table experts add column timezone text;`. The column is nullable, so existing rows aren't affected.
- **Type:** I added `timezone?: string` to `Expert` in `src/experts/types.ts`.

I didn't run the migration or check that the IANA name is valid. The column accepts any text. I also didn't look at the code that reads or writes experts, so nothing sets or returns `timezone` yet.
